selection.principle: Scan 1X2, AH, O/U and BTTS for every candidate match; rank by confidence to win the bet, then publish only selections that still clear 1.80. Publish 0-3 picks only; NO PICK remains valid.
selection.quarter_line_policy: AH/O-U quarter lines (0.25/0.75) may be shown as raw analysis but are not official statistical picks while the public ledger remains WIN/LOSS/PUSH only.
selection.daily_strategy: 2026-09-12 QUEEN SIRIUS PREDICTION 3 · two approved selections · minimum official price 1.80 · no chase · maximum three only when confidence qualifies
tomorrow_flow: Collect the full next-day fixture slate and current market prices.
Evaluate 1X2, Asian Handicap, Over/Under and BTTS for each serious candidate.
Rank every candidate by confidence to win the bet, regardless of market.
Apply the official price gate: decimal odds must be 1.80 or higher.
Exclude quarter-line AH/O-U from official stats while the ledger uses WIN/LOSS/PUSH only.
Publish 0-3 strongest approved selections; never force a pick to reach a quota.
Track live score automatically, settle from final score and keep all results in the existing combined Statistics panel.

settlement.fallback_policy: Use API-Football final-score fallback only after the safe finish window; leave pending on missing or uncertain source data; never force LOSS.
